text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown achieved a brilliant victory 
in the Kyoto Kinen. Having watched the 
race, Duramente approached her and asked 
for a rematch in the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Duramente declares she will move on to the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe next. Those 
words fire up Satono Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To make the name 'Satono' echo throughout 
the entire world. She wanted to become a 
legendary Umamusume worthy of that name.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Kitasan Black declared her 
challenge for the Spring Senior Triple 
Crown, vowing to create a whirlwind at the 
Osaka Hai, Tenno Sho (Spring), and 
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feeling as though a fire has been lit 
under her, Satono Crown sets her sights on 
the Osaka Hai before the Takarazuka Kinen, 
where Duramente awaits.
